notes: TMR Queensland design sheet (Q-series book / TC-series), colour drawing 'not to scale' with a lettered dimension table; every dimension from the sheet, AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. The sheets give no letter widths, so there is no width check. Sheet 'c' is the white edge and 'd' the edge + border (read as AS 1743 does: 10/30 = edge 10 + border 20, 5/15 = 5 + 10, 15/45 = 15 + 30), confirmed against the national R-series pairs. TC-series sheet TC1210_2 'Road train route' special warning sign, page 2 of 4 (2008; pages 1/3 are the 'Smaller vehicles use shoulder' legends for road trains / B-doubles, pages 2/4 the 'Beware when overtaking' legends). Size A generated (B 2100 x 2380 also tabled): r 175, c 16 / d 32 (edge 16 + border 16). Two panels on one outline: top yellow with black border and legend, bottom red with white border and legend, meeting at y 1100 with no divider (the red panel is drawn as three paths with the bottom corners R175 / 159 / 143 over the yellow panel's outline, as the sheet draws it). Right chain p 105 / f 100DM / o 80 / m 750 / k 65 / j 70 / f 100DM / g 65 / f / g 65 / f / e 100 = 1700 (b): title cap top 105, symbol y 285, split 1100, red-panel cap tops 1170, 1335, 1500. Symbol box n 1270 wide centred (x 115) x m 750. 'DN' (the sheet's 'AS1744 Series D Narrow', title and first red line) and 'DM' ('Series D Medium') are both read as plain Series D. Word gaps measured on the sheet: BEWARE-WHEN 90.7, OR-APPROACHING 90.1, ROAD-TRAIN-ROUTE 81.3 / 86.9. Symbol extracted from the sheet PDF's own filled vector paths (tools/symbols/qld_tc1210_truck_car_hill.svg, drawn n x m exactly). Black on retroreflective yellow, white on retroreflective red.
